Digital Marketing Manager - Growth Team

Brightline Software is hiring a Digital Marketing Manager to lead acquisition across paid and organic channels for our B2B SaaS product. You will manage a budget of $1.2M and a team of two.

You will plan and run campaigns across SEO, SEM and email marketing, report on performance with Google Analytics, and work with sales on lead quality.

Must have: 5-7 years in B2B digital marketing, hands-on SEO and SEM, HubSpot, Google Analytics, email marketing and content marketing.
Nice to have: Google Analytics Certification, Salesforce, copywriting experience.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field.
